title: Infections in Persons Who Inject Drugs

questions.question: A patient who injects drugs develops a skin/soft tissue infection.
questions.question_raw: Patient with IVDU develops a skin/soft tissue infection.

parts.text: The patient now develops Vibrio infection. Name 1 drug.
Without using the 1 drug chosen, give 2 regimens (IV may be once daily only, and PO may be twice daily or less frequent).
List 5 marine-borne agents associated with skin/soft tissue infections.

parts_raw.text: Without using the 1 drug chosen, come up with 2 regimens (IV can only be once daily, and PO can only be twice daily or less frequent)
List 5 marine borne agents associated with skin/soft tissue infections

questions.model_answer:
a) (1) Staphylococcus aureus (including MRSA); (2) streptococci — group A and groups C, F, G ("skin popping" injection-drug-use cellulitis of extremities/neck).
b) Doxycycline (a tetracycline) — tetracyclines are first-line for Vibrio vulnificus soft tissue infection; often combined with a third-generation cephalosporin.
c) Using agents other than doxycycline, both with marine/Vibrio activity: (1) Ceftriaxone 1–2 g IV once daily (third-generation cephalosporin); (2) Ciprofloxacin 500 mg PO twice daily (or levofloxacin 750 mg PO once daily). Vibrio spp. are susceptible in vitro to third-generation cephalosporins and fluoroquinolones.
d) (1) Vibrio vulnificus (also V. parahaemolyticus, V. alginolyticus, non-O1 V. cholerae — saltwater/seafood); (2) Aeromonas hydrophila (fresh water); (3) Erysipelothrix rhusiopathiae (erysipeloid — saltwater fish/shellfish handlers); (4) Mycobacterium marinum (aquaria, fish); (5) Vibrio parahaemolyticus.
questions.cohort_conflict: Cohort gives ciprofloxacin as the single Vibrio drug; Mandell makes tetracyclines (doxycycline) first-line with cefotaxime/ciprofloxacin only as alternatives, so doxycycline is the preferred single agent.

cohort_answer.text: Pathogens: GAS, S. aureus. Vibrio drug: Ciprofloxacin. Alternative regimens: IV CRO + doxy, or CRO + levofloxacin (can also use ceftazidime as 3rd gen ceph but dosing frequency 3x daily). Marine-borne agents: Vibrio vulnificus, Plesiomonas sp., Pseudomonas aeruginosa, Mycobacterium marinum, Aeromonas hydrophila, Shewanella spp. (family Vibrionaceae), Streptococcus iniae, Burkholderia pseudomallei.
